let rotateAnimation = CABasicAnimation()
rotateAnimation.valueFunction = CAValueFunction(name: kCAValueFunctionRotateZ)

rotateAnimation.duration = 3
rotatingLayer.add(rotateAnimation,
                  forKey: "transform")
```
